text:
mia: @eng-runtime urgent check for tomorrow's launch post. we need a quick verification run vs our published bench numbers. want a reproducible control cohort and artifacts. deadline: EOD today.
ashwin: ok. what's acceptance criteria and sample set? hosted or dedicated infra?
mia: acceptance: p95 < 650ms hosted, median token cost within 8% of claim, hallucination <= 0.5% on our QA eval. sample: marketing_launch_500.json, seed=2025, size=500, stratify short/med/long. internal link: https://internal/samples/marketing_launch_500.json
jordan: run float16 and q8. marketing will call out quantized numbers.
nashwin: plan: smoke 50 -> full 500; collect per-token heatmap, top-1% traces. will use dedicated-s-4 to reduce noise. I'll put a short README with exact curl + server flags.
sam: include exact curl, headers, batch_size, max_tokens, kv warmup steps. also need CSV for slide chart.
lina: legal wants provenance mapping for samples (id -> source). embargo raw samples.
runtime-bot: run scheduled: run-20250415-09, queue=dedicated-s-4, est 2h. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/run-20250415-09
nashwin: smoke started.
nashwin: smoke done. quick numbers: p50=220ms, p95=620ms, median_token_cost +4.1% vs claim, hallucination 0.3%. uploading artifacts to https://ci.internal/artifacts/marketing/run-20250415-09/smoke. flags: --batch-size=8 --max-tokens=1024 --kv-cache=enabled --allocator=cuda. full run starting soon.
mia: great. once full run is in, we need a 1-slide comparison p50/p95/cost for float16 vs q8. keep raw samples internal.
sam: will produce CSV + slide image. will attach top traces.
nashwin: will update here when full artifacts ready.
mia: thanks all :pray:
